note: What every writer of the PRD 7.2 audit trail agrees on. The schema part is written by services/dataplane/audit (UPDATE_AUDIT_CONTRACT=1); services/gateway/audit and services/collab are held to it. Do not edit the schema by hand.

queries.checks: SELECT r.relname || '.' || conname || '|' || pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 ORDER BY r.relname, conname
queries.columns: SELECT table_name || '.' || column_name || '|' || data_type || '|' || is_nullable || '|' || coalesce(column_default, '') FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = $1 ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position
queries.functions: SELECT p.proname || '|' || regexp_replace(p.prosrc, '\s+', ' ', 'g') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 ORDER BY p.proname
queries.triggers: SELECT r.relname || '.' || t.tgname || '|' || pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY r.relname, t.tgname

functions: expire| DECLARE n bigint; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('picasso.audit_expiry', 'on', true); DELETE FROM <schema>.records WHERE at <= now() - make_interval(days => (SELECT min_days FROM <schema>.retention)); GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT; PERFORM set_config('picasso.audit_expiry', 'off', true); RETURN n; END

guard_delete| BEGIN IF current_setting('picasso.audit_expiry', true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELETE on the audit trail is refused: it is append-only'; END IF; IF OLD.at > now() - make_interval(days => (SELECT min_days FROM <schema>.retention)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'record % is inside the retention period and is kept', OLD.seq; END IF; RETURN OLD; END
refuse| BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION '% on the audit trail is refused: it is append-only', TG_OP; END
stamp| BEGIN NEW.at := now(); RETURN NEW; END
triggers: records.no_change|CREATE TRIGGER no_change BEFORE UPDATE ON <schema>.records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
records.no_delete|CREATE TRIGGER no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON <schema>.records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.guard_delete()
records.no_truncate|CREATE TRIGGER no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON <schema>.records FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
records.stamp|CREATE TRIGGER stamp BEFORE INSERT ON <schema>.records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.stamp()
retention.no_delete|CREATE TRIGGER no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON <schema>.retention FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
retention.no_truncate|CREATE TRIGGER no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON <schema>.retention FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
